entries.title: Investment Morning Brief — August 14, 2026
entries.summary: July retail and food-services sales fell 0.6% m/m, while July headline PPI was flat but core producer costs rose 0.4%. Slower demand momentum and persistent underlying inflation are the morning’s central tension.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 13, 2026
entries.summary: July final-demand PPI was unchanged month over month and up 4.7% year over year, while the less-food, energy and trade-services measure rose 0.4%. A softer headline, sticky core production costs, and AI earnings dispersion set the morning’s risk frame.

entries.title: Close Investment Brief — August 12, 2026
entries.summary: A modest July inflation deceleration and AI-infrastructure earnings delivery lifted U.S. equities; the S&P 500 and Nasdaq neared records while the Dow slipped, leaving rates, oil, and housing as important counter-signals.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 12, 2026
entries.summary: Ahead of CPI, U.S. futures were modestly higher after Tuesday's broad-index pullback and an $88.91 Brent close. CoreWeave and Super Micro's earnings-driven premarket gains put AI infrastructure delivery and capital intensity alongside inflation at the center of the session.

entries.title: Close Investment Brief — August 11, 2026
entries.summary: U.S. stocks completed a second modest retreat from record territory as volatile oil, elevated inflation risk and a pre-CPI wait outweighed selective earnings strength.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 11, 2026
entries.summary: August 10 equities eased from records while Brent rose about 5% on Strait of Hormuz uncertainty. CoreWeave's results tonight and Wednesday's CPI test AI-capex and inflation pricing.

entries.title: Close Investment Brief — August 10, 2026
entries.summary: U.S. equities slipped modestly below records as oil jumped on Hormuz uncertainty, long Treasury yields rose, and technology weighed; Berkshire’s profit beat offered a contrasting quality-and-capital-allocation signal.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 10, 2026
entries.summary: After July payrolls unexpectedly fell by 23,000, equities reached new highs and Treasury yields declined on August 7. This week’s CPI, PPI and AI-infrastructure earnings test that rates-and-earnings narrative.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 7, 2026
entries.summary: The July Employment Situation at 08:30 ET is the immediate macro risk event after Thursday’s oil-led rise in yields and modest equity pullback. This brief separates verified August 6 closes from unavailable live premarket data.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 6, 2026
entries.summary: The early-August setup is a three-way test: post-earnings dispersion, Treasury financing after the August 5 refunding, and the 08:30 ET productivity release. Verified real-time futures, ETF flows and credit/option positioning are unavailable.

entries.title: Close Investment Brief — August 5, 2026
entries.summary: U.S. equities finished unevenly near records: the Dow gained while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq eased as investors differentiated between AI demand beneficiaries and heavy AI spenders. Lower oil and slightly lower long yields helped, but did not erase valuation and geopolitical risks.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 5, 2026
entries.summary: Record-setting U.S. equities enter Wednesday with earnings-led AI enthusiasm, but AMD's post-results decline, today's services/labor releases and Treasury's refunding announcement make breadth, rates and financing conditions the real tests.

entries.title: Closing Investment Brief — August 4, 2026
entries.summary: U.S. equities closed at records as strong earnings, lower oil and lower long yields widened an early earnings-led rally. The key read-through is a simultaneous repricing of AI demand, industrial order strength and a smaller near-term inflation premium—not a clean all-clear on valuation or geopolitics.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 4, 2026
entries.summary: Monday's oil-led relief rally left the S&P 500 within 0.1% of its record. Before the open, modestly positive futures, Caterpillar's scheduled results and 10:00 ET JOLTS shift attention from Iran headlines to earnings and labor-market evidence.

entries.title: Closing Investment Brief — August 3, 2026
entries.summary: U.S. equities finished sharply higher as oil and Treasury yields fell on Iran de-escalation hopes. The close confirmed broad risk appetite, but the underlying message was selective: fuel-cost beneficiaries and aerospace rallied while AI hardware remained volatile.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — August 3, 2026
entries.summary: A pause in new U.S. strikes on Iran has pushed oil and long yields lower, lifting risk assets; semiconductor shares remain split on the durability of AI returns. This week's ISM, JOLTS, jobs and productivity releases test whether growth, inflation and valuation can improve together.

entries.title: U.S. Market Close Investment Brief | 2026-07-31
entries.summary: Stocks finished July higher on Amazon's earnings signal, while Apple's outlook, higher oil and rising long yields kept risk appetite selective.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — July 31, 2026
entries.summary: The overnight question has shifted from AI spending to monetisation: Amazon reported faster AWS growth and higher capex, while Apple beat on revenue; today’s 08:30 ET ECI is the first wage-cost test after the Fed’s hawkish split.

entries.title: U.S. Market Close Investment Brief | 2026-07-30
entries.summary: Microsoft validated part of the AI-profit story, lifting the S&P 500 about 1.8% and Nasdaq about 2.9%; Meta capex and inflation remain the valuation fault lines.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — July 30, 2026
entries.summary: Microsoft’s cloud delivery is lifting technology futures while Meta’s cost and free-cash-flow pressure provides the counterexample; three Fed hike dissents and the 08:30 ET GDP/PCE releases put rates, AI capex and energy risk into one session.

entries.title: US Equity Closing Investment Brief | 2026-07-29
entries.summary: The Fed held rates, but renewed oil inflation and AI valuation scrutiny drove SPY down 1.50% and QQQ down 2.01%.

entries.title: Morning Investment Brief — July 29, 2026
entries.summary: Oil has rebounded on renewed Middle East tension while U.S. index futures are split; the FOMC decision and after-hours Microsoft and Meta results put policy, energy and AI valuation into one event-heavy session.

entries.title: Closing Investment Brief | 2026-07-28
entries.summary: The Dow led, the S&P 500 edged higher and the Nasdaq fell as easing oil met a sharp rotation away from AI chips.

entries.title: 2026-07-28 Morning Market Brief
entries.summary: This morning's setup is defined by another AI-chip de-risking wave, lower oil and softer long-end yields helping the Dow and defensive earnings winners, and a Fed-plus-earnings calendar that keeps volatility elevated.

entries.title: 2026-07-27 Closing Investment Brief (Based on the latest completed session, 2026-07-24)
entries.summary: Intel's post-earnings strength and a pullback in oil stabilized the Dow and S&P 500, but the Nasdaq stayed under pressure from AI capex skepticism ahead of the Fed and mega-cap earnings

entries.title: 2026-07-27 Morning Market Brief
entries.summary: Monday's premarket is being driven by easing Iran-related risk, sharply lower oil, softer Treasury yields, a modestly constructive durable-goods report, and a high-stakes week of FOMC and mega-cap AI earnings.

entries.title: 2026-07-26 Morning Market Brief
entries.summary: There is no regular U.S. equity premarket on Sunday, so the setup is a weekend handoff: oil and rates remain the key macro pressure points, while the Fed, GDP/PCE/ECI and mega-cap earnings define the week ahead.

entries.title: 2026-07-24 Morning Market Brief
entries.summary: Oil's pullback is helping a short-term rebound, but elevated yields and AI capex scrutiny still limit risk appetite; Intel, Verizon, American Express and Charter drive the early single-stock signal.

entries.title: 2026-07-23 Closing Investment Brief
entries.summary: Oil above $100 and AI capex anxiety drove a Nasdaq-led selloff, with after-hours focus shifting to Intel
